mapper.sql: g.Id AS id, g.IdMedico AS medicoId, LEFT(g.FGuardia, 10) AS fecha, g.Festivo AS festivo, g.Tipo AS tipo, g.IdServicio AS servicioId
mapper.select: SELECT , m.Nombre AS medicoNombre, m.Apellidos AS medicoApellidos FROM guardias_medicos g LEFT JOIN medicos m ON m.ID = g.IdMedico WHERE g.Id = #{id}
SELECT s.IdServicio FROM guardias_servicios s WHERE s.IdServicio = #{servicioId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT , NULL AS medicoNombre, NULL AS medicoApellidos FROM guardias_medicos g WHERE g.Id IN #{id} ORDER BY g.Id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE guardias_medicos SET IdMedico = #{medicoId} WHERE Id = #{guardiaId}
UPDATE guardias_medicos SET Tipo = #{tipo} WHERE Id = #{guardiaId}
